summary: Keep an in-progress login after navigation timeouts, preserve SSO redirects, and stop polling lost browser sessions.
reason: This downstream CLI owns a pinned browser helper. Navigation failures were incorrectly treated as missing Chrome, SSO redirects were navigated away from, and helper reads could relaunch a closed browser. Successful session validation must be distinguished from the subsequent user account-confirmation checkpoint.
validated_outcome: Synthetic browser tests cover timeout recovery, missing-browser-only installation, uninterrupted SSO, confirmed lost-window fail-stop behavior, and separate connected/account-confirmation output. Unanswered status probes remain unknown and are retried within the login deadline, without navigation or cookie reads until status recovers. Fixed error categories distinguish transport failures from confirmed closure without leaking helper output. Real user login remains a manual acceptance check. The pinned helper has no atomic no-relaunch read, so a browser close between a successful session probe and its next read remains a helper-level race.
